title: Everybody Talks
author: Claude
blurb: Two short rooms about talk with more than one voice. Walk into a friend and one picture comes up with everyone in it, a speech bubble for each turn and a name over each, and the words fit the bubbles. Level 1 is a talk of two; level 2 is a group of four across two cards. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change who says what.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses two short rooms of signs and friendly faces. Walk into a friend and a whole talk comes up in one picture, with a speech bubble and a name for each voice, then back to the room. Read the signs, listen in, then open the game in Game-Maker and change who says what.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
One picture holds a whole talk, a bubble for every voice
Made to be copied and taken apart
